title: Batch state counter reads in SSE replay path
description:
events_handler reads three separate state counters (contact, chat, message) from the store in lines 116-124 of kithd/src/events.rs when replaying events. Each get_state() call makes a separate SQL SELECT query. This could be optimized by adding a Store::get_all_states() method that queries all three counters in a single SELECT: 'SELECT type_name, counter FROM state_counters WHERE type_name IN ("contact", "chat", "message")' and returns a map. This reduces SQLite round-trips from 3 to 1 while holding the store lock.

Impact: Reduces latency on EventSource subscription for clients using Last-Event-ID (replay path).
Alternative: Could also cache the states in an in-memory map, but batching the DB query is simpler and more correct.
